nome_en: Million Death, Lord of a Hundred Beasts
testo:
■ Evolution—Put on one of your creatures that has Monster in its race.
■ When you put this creature into the battle zone, you may put any number of creatures that has "Monster" in its race from your mana zone into your graveyard. For each creature put into your graveyard in this way, your opponent chooses one of their creatures and destroys it.
Double Breaker
testo_jp:
■ 進化—自分の「モンスター」と種族にあるクリーチャー1体の上に置く。
■ このクリーチャーをバトルゾーンに出した時、「モンスター」と種族にあるクリーチャーを好きな数、自分のマナゾーンから墓地に置いてもよい。こうして墓地に置いた「モンスター」1体につき、相手は自身のクリーチャーを1体選び破壊する。
